description: End a navigation session: on arrival, when the traveller gives up, or before starting another trip. Pass `session_id`. The gateway drops the route and the last position it held. A session that has already gone (idle for 2 hours, ended earlier, or dropped by a gateway restart) answers `ended: true` with a note, not an error. Ending finished sessions matters because each account holds a limited number of live ones. Requires the MapMap gateway (GATEWAY_URL + GATEWAY_API_KEY); see /docs/navigation-sessions.
name: end_navigation

ended.description: True once the session is gone: ended now, or already gone.

title: End a navigation session
